review_scope: Read-only line-by-line mathematics/code/test/derivation review of a disabled artificial CPU prototype; file/hash/Git-blob recovery metadata checks only.

proof_checks.reason: For s=2^96 and k=isqrt(floor(x*s^2)), k^2<=x*s^2<(k+1)^2. Exact grid roots use equal bounds; otherwise the upper bound is strictly above the root. Positive roots with lower zero cannot enter the division branch.

For dot(a,delta)<0 and certified acute cone, dot*cos_lower+abs(cross)*sin_upper bounds every permitted unnormalized projection. Original nonclosing=True independently proves a robust nonpositive whole-sector support, including its tangent zero special case, so preserving exact zero is safe.

The numerator H+U*axis_norm_upper is an upper bound. With a positive numerator, dividing by positive axis/delta norm lower bounds preserves an upper bound. The ratio is dimensionless; the final length is L times that ratio. The additional contribution is approximately L*U/d, while the original full additive U stays outside. Nonpositive numerator is zero before division; cap at one is independently justified by the length-L sector.

Each sector includes radius zero, hence nonnegative support. Multiple possible signs/headings form a union, so their maximum is used. Absent directions preserve the complete L disk; validated Reach buffer/length fields are used unchanged.

For delta=p_right-p_left, left support uses delta and right support uses -delta. Projecting delta+x_right-x_left+position_error on n=delta/|delta| gives the lower bound d-h_left(n)-h_right(-n)-buffers-U. The exact squared comparison against a nonnegative required distance certifies this sufficient declared-set separation condition, including equality; zero delta rejects.

Source ages remain builtin integers in [0,500000000] ns; boolean hard gates/calibration are explicit. Original U=SPEED*sum(ages) is preserved. Map and raw complete frame certificates are separately formed and ANDed without borrowing distance or axes across frames.

Every original accepted nonclosing component retains zero. Every remaining component is bounded in [0,L], and union max is at most original retained L. Buffers/U/hard gates and frame conjunction are identical; thus every original PASS remains a new conditional geometric PASS. This does not assert gate equivalence or native permission.

The artificial helper preserves phi=(6/5)*(age+39/50), original disk/normal/transition constructors and sign validation. Tests cover units with rational norms, right-normal sign, frames, union, old PASS implication, thresholds, fallbacks and numerical cone checks; the approximate numeric oracle and fixed random search are explicitly implementation bug detectors, not proofs.

cpu_evidence.basis: Only the root-executed sealed actual-wait receipt and console; independent reviewer did not import or execute the prototype or tests.

limitations: The support comparison is sufficient for separation conditional on the declared Reach sets; it is not an exact distance solver and does not establish a continuous physical model, calibration, delivery, source freshness in a real run or actual mode commitment.
The prototype is a new scientific admission candidate, not a semantics-preserving replacement of the old binary rule. No old FAIL is changed and no native/95-percent/task/PPO credit is granted.
The extra directional uncertainty is deliberate additional conservatism. No additive outer U or original 2R/4R buffer is removed.
No original runtime trace, compressed actor input, real-scene geometry or scientific replay was read or executed for this review.
Future production use requires an explicit new rule/schema, mutually consistent producer/readers/source registries, new freeze and complete native qualification under unchanged remaining obligations.
